acceptance_predicates.description: A bounded credential-backed OpenRouter smoke is attempted at the exact ASB head and its outcome is truthful.
Missing or invalid credentials, timeout, transport, and provider failures are typed and nonzero.
Explicit live failure never silently changes to local mock or replay.
The qualification receipt contains no credentials, raw responses, or private paths.

definition_of_done: Exact-head live smoke and credential-free negative evidence are recorded.
Independent review, hosted checks, and privacy validation pass.

inputs.description: Reviewed provider, model, agent, and workload selection.

gates.description: The selected live path reaches the provider or returns a typed provider outcome.
No credentials or raw provider payloads enter durable state.
